units.source_text: 我在应该年轻的时候是苍老的，到应该老了的时候又年轻了。

en.t: When I should have been young, I was old, and when I should have grown old, I became young again.

units.source_text: 因此我不像一般老河童一样欲望枯竭，也不像一般年轻河童一样沉迷美色。

en.t: Therefore, unlike ordinary old kappas, my desires have not dried up, and unlike ordinary young kappas, I am not infatuated with beauty.

units.source_text: 总之，我的生活就算不是幸福的，起码也是安宁的。”

en.t: In short, even if my life is not happy, at least it is peaceful.
